# Assignment 1. Handwritten digit recognition with K-nearest neighbors

```{r a1-data}
library(kknn)

# optdigits.csv has no header: 64 pixel columns + last column = digit (0-9)
digits <- read.csv("data/optdigits.csv", header = FALSE)
colnames(digits)[ncol(digits)] <- "digit"
digits$digit <- as.factor(digits$digit)
```

## 1. Data partitioning

```{r a1-split}
n <- dim(digits)[1]
set.seed(12345)
id_train <- sample(1:n, floor(n * 0.5))
train <- digits[id_train,]

id_tmp <- setdiff(1:n, id_train)
set.seed(12345)
id_valid <- sample(id_tmp, floor(n * 0.25))
valid <- digits[id_valid,]

id_test <- setdiff(id_tmp, id_valid)
test <- digits[id_test,]
```

## 2. 30-nearest neighbor classifier

```{r a1-knn30}
# Fits models
fit_train <- kknn(
  digit ~ ., train = train, test = train, k = 30, kernel = "rectangular"
)
fit_test <- kknn(
  digit ~ ., train = train, test = test, k = 30, kernel = "rectangular"
)
```

```{r a1-knn30-errors}
# Gets confusion matrices
cm_train <- table(True = train$digit, Predicted = fit_train$fitted.values)
cm_test <- table(True = test$digit, Predicted = fit_test$fitted.values)

# Defines missclass function to calculate classification error
missclass <- function(true, predicted) {
  n <- length(true)
  1 - sum(diag(table(true, predicted))) / n
}

# Calculates errors
print("Train classification error:")
print(round(missclass(train$digit, fit_train$fitted.values), 4))
print("Test classification error:")
print(round(missclass(test$digit, fit_test$fitted.values), 4))

# Defines digit_missclass function to get each digit's classification error
digit_missclass <- function(true, predicted) {
  1 - diag(table(true, predicted)) / rowSums(table(true, predicted))
}

# Calculates each digit's classification error
print("Train classification error per digit:")
print(round(digit_missclass(train$digit, fit_train$fitted.values), 4))
print("Test classification error per digit:")
print(round(digit_missclass(test$digit, fit_test$fitted.values), 4))
```

## 3. Easiest and hardest cases of digit "8"

```{r a1-digit8, fig.show="hold", out.width="19%", fig.width=3, fig.height=3.3}
# Gets the predicted probabilities for the digit 8
idx_8 <- which(train$digit == "8")
prob_8 <- fit_train$prob[idx_8, "8"]

# Gets the 2 samples of 8 with the highest probability and the 3 with the lowest
easiest <- idx_8[order(prob_8, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]]
hardest <- idx_8[order(prob_8)[1:3]]

# Reshapes one training row into the 8x8 image (pixels are stored row by row)
plot_digit <- function(i, title) {
  img <- matrix(as.numeric(train[i, 1:64]), nrow = 8, byrow = TRUE)
  # heatmap() draws row 1 at the bottom, so reverse the rows to show the
  # digit upright; scale = "none" keeps the raw pixel counts
  heatmap(
    img[8:1, ], Colv = NA, Rowv = NA, scale = "none", labRow = NA, labCol = NA,
    main = title, col = grey(seq(1, 0, length.out = 17))
  )
}

for (i in easiest) {
  plot_digit(i, sprintf("Easy: p = %.2f", fit_train$prob[i, "8"]))
}
for (i in hardest) {
  plot_digit(i, sprintf("Hard: p = %.2f", fit_train$prob[i, "8"]))
}
```


## 4. Misclassification error for K = 1, ..., 30

```{r a1-misclass}
get_knn_missclass_error <- function(train, valid, k) {
  # Fits models
  fit_train <- kknn(
    digit ~ ., train = train, test = train, k = k, kernel = "rectangular"
  )
  fit_valid <- kknn(
    digit ~ ., train = train, test = valid, k = k, kernel = "rectangular"
  )

  # Calculates train and validation error rates
  error_train <- missclass(train$digit, fit_train$fitted.values)
  error_valid <- missclass(valid$digit, fit_valid$fitted.values)

  c(error_train = error_train, error_valid = error_valid)
}

# Calculates errors for each value of k from 1 to 30
errors <- sapply(1:30, function(k) get_knn_missclass_error(train, valid, k))
```

```{r a1-misclass-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Training and validation misclassification error for k = 1, ..., 30."}
k_values <- 1:30
k_opt <- which.min(errors["error_valid", ])
col_train <- "#2a78d6"  # blue
col_valid <- "#eb6834"  # orange

# Plots an empty plot first so the grid and the k marker sit behind the lines
plot(
  k_values, errors["error_train",], type = "n", xaxt = "n",
  xlim = c(1, 34), ylim = c(0, max(errors)), las = 1, bty = "l",
  xlab = "k (number of neighbours)", ylab = "Misclassification error"
)
axis(1, at = c(1, seq(5, 30, by = 5)))
abline(h = axTicks(2), col = "grey90")
abline(v = k_opt, lty = 2, col = "grey50")

# Adds lines with train and validation errors
lines(
  k_values, errors["error_train", ], type = "o", pch = 19, cex = 0.7,
  lwd = 2, col = col_train
)
lines(
  k_values, errors["error_valid", ], type = "o", pch = 17, cex = 0.8,
  lwd = 2, col = col_valid
)

# Labels at the right end of each line, and the optimal K
text(30, errors[, 30], c("Training", "Validation"), pos = 4, cex = 0.85)
text(
  k_opt, max(errors), paste("optimal k =", k_opt), pos = 4, cex = 0.85,
  col = "grey30"
)
legend(
  "bottomright", legend = c("Training", "Validation"),
  col = c(col_train, col_valid), pch = c(19, 17), lwd = 2, bty = "n"
  )
```


## 5. Cross-entropy for K = 1, ..., 30

```{r a1-crossentropy}
get_knn_cross_entropy <- function(train, valid, k) {
  fit_valid <- kknn(
    digit ~ ., train = train, test = valid, k = k, kernel = "rectangular"
  )
  prob <- fit_valid$prob

  # Indicator matrix I(Y_i = C_m): one row per observation, one column per digit
  Y <- outer(valid$digit, colnames(prob), "==")

  # Cross-entropy as on Lecture 1a, slide 27 (1e-15 avoids log(0))
  -sum(Y * log(prob + 1e-15))
}

cross_entropy <- sapply(
  1:30, function(k) get_knn_cross_entropy(train, valid, k)
)
```

```{r a1-crossentropy-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Validation cross-entropy for k = 1, ..., 30."}
k_values <- 1:30
k_opt_ce <- which.min(cross_entropy)
col_valid <- "#eb6834"  # orange, as the validation line in the Task 4 plot

# Plots an empty plot first so the grid and the k marker sit behind the line
plot(
  k_values, cross_entropy, type = "n", xaxt = "n",
  ylim = c(0, max(cross_entropy)), las = 1, bty = "l",
  xlab = "k (number of neighbours)", ylab = "Validation cross-entropy"
)
axis(1, at = c(1, seq(5, 30, by = 5)))
abline(h = axTicks(2), col = "grey90")
abline(v = k_opt_ce, lty = 2, col = "grey50")

# Adds the validation cross-entropy line
lines(
  k_values, cross_entropy, type = "o", pch = 17, cex = 0.8,
  lwd = 2, col = col_valid
)

# Marks the optimal k
text(
  k_opt_ce, max(cross_entropy), paste("optimal k =", k_opt_ce),
  pos = 4, cex = 0.85, col = "grey30"
)
```
